summary: Kirby boots on AMD, older GeForce cards render correctly again, and some games run faster.
summary_zh_CN: 修复了《星之卡比 探索发现》在部分 AMD 显卡上的启动问题和旧款 GeForce 显卡的画面异常，并提升了部分游戏的运行性能。

changes.title: Kirby and the Forgotten Land
changes.title_zh_CN: 《星之卡比 探索发现》启动修复
changes.body: The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition no longer crashes at launch on affected AMD GPUs. Garbled loading text is also fixed.
changes.body_zh_CN: 修复 Nintendo Switch 2 版在部分 AMD 显卡上启动时崩溃的问题，以及加载文字显示错乱的问题。

changes.title: Graphics on older GeForce cards
changes.title_zh_CN: 旧款 GeForce 显卡的画面修复
changes.body: Fixes corruption on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 10-series and older cards. Your shader cache rebuilds once after updating.
changes.body_zh_CN: 修复 NVIDIA GeForce GTX 10 系列及更早型号显卡上的画面异常。更新后，着色器缓存会重建一次。

changes.title: Faster gameplay
changes.title_zh_CN: 改善部分游戏的运行性能
changes.body: Ocarina of Time and Donkey Kong Bananza run faster in some scenes, and crowded scenes in Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave can run more smoothly. Gains vary with your hardware and settings.
changes.body_zh_CN: 《时之笛》和《咚奇刚 蕉力全开》在部分场景中运行更快，Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave 在单位密集的场景中也可能更流畅。实际改善幅度取决于硬件和设置。

changes.title: Faster first-time shader compiles
changes.body: Some large shaders compile faster when you first encounter them, reducing stalls in games such as Ocarina of Time.
changes.body_zh_CN: 部分大型着色器的首次编译耗时缩短，减少了《时之笛》等游戏运行中的卡顿。

changes.title: Safer NUP metadata edits
changes.title_zh_CN: 编辑 NUP 元数据时保留构建 ID
changes.body: Changing an NUP's name, version, or icon no longer strips the Build IDs used to match patches and cheats.
changes.body_zh_CN: 修改 NUP 的名称、版本或图标时，会保留用于匹配补丁和金手指的构建 ID。

changes.title: More game graphics fixes
changes.body: Restores correct colors in Xenoblade Chronicles 2's Switch 2 Edition. Mario Kart World avoids a crash from an oversized lightmap on some low-VRAM GPUs.
changes.body_zh_CN: 恢复《异度神剑 2》Switch 2 版的正确色彩，并修复《马力欧卡丁车 世界》因超大光照贴图而在部分低显存显卡上崩溃的问题。

changes.title: Album, HDR, and multiplayer fixes
changes.title_zh_CN: 相册、HDR 和多人游戏修复
changes.body: Album screenshots show thumbnails again. Games get notified when HDR turns on, and multiplayer rooms can connect over Tailscale and WireGuard.
changes.body_zh_CN: 相册截图恢复显示缩略图。启用 HDR 时，游戏会收到通知。多人房间支持通过 Tailscale 和 WireGuard 连接。
